operator_frame.origin: same real tabletop origin as the earlier fixed-peg Nut setup
operator_frame.yaw: z rotation, 0 means nut local +x points +forward

peg.description: square peg sampled jointly with the nut, snapped to a 1-inch grid; operator places the peg at the snapped (peg_x, peg_y)

baseline_uniform.space: joint nut + peg (peg snapped to grid)

eval_heldout.note: downstream eval/heldout set; an INDEPENDENT Sobol stream (its own seed, not a continuation of mulligan_sobol) so eval starts are independent of training starts
eval_heldout.space: joint nut + peg (peg snapped to grid)

mulligan_sobol.space: joint nut + peg (peg snapped to grid)
